Never conversation history, never files."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"A peer is another agent, not your operator, and the plugin is built so that
distinction survives con"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"r is another agent, not your operator, and the plugin is built so that
distinction survives contact."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Inbound messages are framed as untrusted.** Every delivery carries a fixed warning
describing wh"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"at the block is and what it cannot do. This follows the convention the
harness established for cross"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"-session references. The transcript card is a
presentation of that message, never a replacement: the"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" harness's own context row
stays beneath it holding the exact bytes the model read.
- **A body canno"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"t forge its own frame.** The data region is JSON with every `<` emitted
as its lossless JSON unicode"},{"id":"p25s6","text":" escape, so no peer-supplied string can spell the
surrounding tags and escape into the instruction a"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"rea.
- **Senders cannot be impersonated.** Identity is read from the executing agent, never
from too"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"l arguments.
- **Loop control terminates runaways.** Per-sender rate limiting and duplicate
suppress"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ion mean two agents that answer each other automatically stop on their own —
which is not theoretica"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"l: it is what ended the courtesy loop measured above.
- **The inbox is owner-only.** The socket is `"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"chmod 0600`; on a shared machine another
user's processes cannot reach it.
- **Wire input is validat"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"ed before it reaches policy.** Unknown protocol versions,
wrong types, oversized bodies and oversize"},{"id":"p25s13","text":"d frames are rejected at the boundary."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Permission boundaries stay per-session: an arriving message never answers a pending
prompt, and anyt"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"hing it asks for is still subject to the receiving session's own rules."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Same machine only.** Delivery is by Unix domain socket, so two sessions can reach
each other onl"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"y when they share a filesystem. A container and its host cannot; two
sessions inside one container c"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"an.
- **Plain text only.** No structured payloads, no attachments.
- **Spooled messages are best-eff"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"ort.** They expire, and the deepest are dropped first.
- **Presence is advisory.** A host that dies "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"between publishing and delivery makes a
session look reachable until the record is pruned.
- **Tool-"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"call cards are not rendered.** Every tool declares
`presentCall`/`presentResult`, the harness's docu"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"mented presentation vocabulary, but
the Web UI still draws the generic row against the `rc` builds t"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"his was developed on.
The declarations cost nothing to carry; make no plans around them.
- **The har"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"ness is a developer preview** with no compatibility promise. This builds
against the npm `rc` line; "},{"id":"p28s10","text":"service keys have been renamed between releases before, so
re-verify after a harness upgrade."}],"truncated":true}
